items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: the first time I heard Kid Renier it was really odd

ctx.x: What band you like on the advertisements? You know, I used to play the advertisements like, you know, Gilbert Renier, Chris Kelly,

Punch and all that. Oh yeah, like, well, Kid Renier was another one. It was a pleasure. I mean, he was in the top lot. Oh yeah, he was a pleasure. You know, the first time I heard Kid Renier it was really odd. I had been hearing about Kid Renier for years. And when I heard him and I saw him, in fact, he didn't even seem to be a type of man to me. I thought he was a great big fella, the way he used to talk about him, but he was a very small fella.
